message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It was discovered in 2013 and is a young, massive gas giant orbiting the star HD 100546. Its radius is about **2.5–3 times that of Jupiter**, making it the biggest planet we’ve found in our galaxy (and, by extension, the largest known planet in the entire observable universe).
